name: issue-tracking
title: Issue filing & QA (Jira, GitHub)
summary: file-jira-issue drafts six-word, four-block tickets under the right epic with real ADF links, through the jira-mcp server (installed into .mcp.json); file-github-issue files the same shape of issue on GitHub with the gh CLI; test-issue QA-verifies a Jira ticket's fix against the app running locally and posts an honest verdict comment.

cli.name: gh
cli.why: file-github-issue searches, creates and edits issues with the GitHub CLI (authenticated with gh auth login).

env.name: JIRA_EMAIL
env.why: Atlassian account email the jira-mcp server authenticates with. Set it in your shell profile or the git-ignored .claude/settings.local.json env block — never in .mcp.json.

env.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
env.why: Atlassian API token (id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens) for the jira-mcp server. Same place as JIRA_EMAIL; never committed.

vendorSkills.why: test-issue drives the app in a real browser.

issueSkills.prompt: Which issue-tracking skills should be installed?

choices.label: file-jira-issue
choices.description: Draft, confirm and file well-formed Jira tickets.

choices.label: test-issue
choices.description: QA-verify a Jira ticket's fix locally and post a verdict comment.

choices.label: file-github-issue
choices.description: Draft, confirm and file well-formed GitHub issues with gh.

codeWork.prompt: Do codebase Jira tickets go under one standing epic with a [layer] prefix on the summary?

choices.label: No
choices.description: Tickets go under whatever epic fits.

choices.label: Yes
choices.description: Asks for the epic key and installs a layer-prefix roster to fill in.

JIRA_PROJECT.prompt: Project key tickets are created in (e.g. ABC)

JIRA_MCP_SERVER.prompt: Name for the Jira MCP server in .mcp.json (tools become mcp__<name>__jira_*)

JIRA_CODE_EPIC.prompt: Epic key codebase tickets go under (e.g. ABC-123)

GITHUB_REPO.prompt: GitHub repository issues are filed in (owner/name)
GITHUB_REPO.infer: the origin remote, when it is on github.com

todo.text: Set JIRA_EMAIL and JIRA_API_TOKEN in your shell profile or the git-ignored .claude/settings.local.json env block, then start a new session: Claude Code asks once to approve the project MCP server from .mcp.json.
If `gh auth status` fails, run `gh auth login` (the token needs the repo scope) before filing GitHub issues.
